access_request.subject: {{.Admin}} is requesting access to {{.Tenant}}
access_request.heading: Platform access requested
access_request.intro: {{.Admin}} from {{.Brand}} is asking for access to your project space. Nothing is opened until an owner or admin approves.

access_approved.subject: Your access to {{.Tenant}} was approved
access_approved.heading: Access approved
access_approved.intro: {{.Actor}} approved your access request. It ends automatically at the time below.

access_denied.subject: Your access request for {{.Tenant}} was denied
access_denied.heading: Access denied

access_revoked.subject: Your access to {{.Tenant}} was revoked
access_revoked.heading: Access revoked
access_revoked.intro: {{.Actor}} revoked your access. Open sessions are refused from now on.

access_expired.subject: Access to {{.Tenant}} has ended
access_expired.heading: Access ended
access_expired.intro: The time-boxed access below reached its time limit and was closed automatically.

breakglass.subject: Emergency access was used on {{.Tenant}}
breakglass.heading: Emergency (break-glass) access
breakglass.intro: {{.Admin}} from {{.Brand}} used emergency access to your project space. Every action during it is recorded in your audit log.

workspace_ready.subject: Your workspace {{.Workspace}} is ready
workspace_ready.heading: Workspace ready
workspace_ready.intro: {{.Workspace}} in {{.Tenant}} finished setting up and is running.
